name: BinHV45 Bollinger break with candle anatomy
note: The BinHV45 conjunction: a close below the PREVIOUS bar's lower band (so the breaking bar does not widen the band it must break), no higher than the previous close, and three bar-geometry magnitudes each normalised to a different denominator -- band width bbdelta/close, bar displacement closedelta/close, and wick length tail/bbdelta, which must be SMALL because the close has to sit on the low with no dip-buying absorption yet. THRESHOLD NOTE: the published 0.007/0.017/0.025 were tuned on crypto and the source explicitly says to re-sweep them; measured on real 5-minute equity bars the same three ratios differ by more than 10x across symbols (median bbdelta/close is 0.0015 on SPY and 0.020 on SOXL), so one absolute constant cannot mean the same thing on two names. Each ratio is therefore compared to its own trailing q_win-bar percentile, which is the same conjunction self-calibrated per instrument. Exit is the first close back above the 40-bar mid, with a 20-bar time stop.
code:
def family_init(ctx):
    import math
    from bisect import insort, bisect_left
    bars = ctx.bars
    N = len(bars)
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    lo = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    P = max(5, int(ctx.p.bb_n))
    k = float(ctx.p.bb_k)
    W = max(60, int(ctx.p.q_win))

    mid = [None] * N
    low = [None] * N
    bbd = [None] * N
    s = 0.0
    q = 0.0
    for j in range(N):
        s += c[j]
        q += c[j] * c[j]
        if j >= P:
            s -= c[j - P]
            q -= c[j - P] * c[j - P]
        if j >= P - 1:
            m = s / P
            var = q / P - m * m
            sd = math.sqrt(var) if var > 1e-18 else 0.0
            mid[j] = m
            low[j] = m - k * sd
            bbd[j] = k * sd

    r1 = [None] * N
    r2 = [None] * N
    r3 = [None] * N
    for j in range(N):
        d = bbd[j]
        if d is None or c[j] <= 0:
            continue
        r1[j] = d / c[j]
        if j >= 1:
            r2[j] = abs(c[j] - c[j - 1]) / c[j]
        if d > 0:
            r3[j] = abs(c[j] - lo[j]) / d

    def ranks(x):
        out = [None] * N
        buf = []
        seq = []
        head = 0
        for j in range(N):
            xv = x[j]
            if xv is None:
                continue
            n = len(buf)
            if n >= 40:
                out[j] = bisect_left(buf, xv) / float(n)
            insort(buf, xv)
            seq.append(xv)
            if len(buf) > W:
                old = seq[head]
                head += 1
                del buf[bisect_left(buf, old)]
        return out

    ctx.q1 = ctx.series(ranks(r1), "bbdelta_rank")
    ctx.q2 = ctx.series(ranks(r2), "closedelta_rank")
    ctx.q3 = ctx.series(ranks(r3), "tail_rank")
    ctx.lb = ctx.series(low, "lower")
    ctx.mb = ctx.series(mid, "mid")


def signal(ctx, i):
    if i < 1:
        return 0
    a = ctx.q1[i]
    b = ctx.q2[i]
    t = ctx.q3[i]
    lb = ctx.lb[i - 1]
    if a is None or b is None or t is None or lb is None or lb <= 0:
        return 0
    if a < float(ctx.p.bb_q):
        return 0
    if b < float(ctx.p.cd_q):
        return 0
    if t > float(ctx.p.tail_q):
        return 0
    cn = ctx.c[i]
    if cn >= lb:
        return 0
    if cn > ctx.c[i - 1]:
        return 0
    return 1


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    m = ctx.mb[i]
    if m is None:
        return False
    return ctx.c[i] > m
